title: Kyle Pitts believes "there's a lot more out there" for him after signing new deal

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Pitts believes "there's a lot more out there" for him after signing new deal
sources.description: When Kyle Pitts signed the franchise tag on April 7, the Falcons tight end figured he was playing 2026 under the one-year, $15.045 million tag.
